Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 5: the slip of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“During battle at a site with R2-D2, may not be targeted by weapons, and may draw one destiny; subtract that amount from opponent's total power. Once per game, may place all your non-[Immune to Alter] Effects on table in Used Pile.”), word for word the text of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio) (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
